title: Differential forms on regular affine algebras
container-title: Transactions of the American Mathematical Society
note: The Hochschild–Kostant–Rosenberg theorem: for a smooth (regular) commutative algebra over a field of characteristic 0, Hochschild homology is the module of differential forms, HH_n(A) = Omega^n_A. Cited by rem:hkr-theorem as a THEOREM about the commutative fibre; the q != 1 identification is not this theorem (see conj:wigner-axiom and docs/audits/2026-09-15-chi-as-a-component-of-the-chern-character.md).
